questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.topic: The claim a covering letter makes
questions.stem: Item 0001 asks what a covering letter primarily claims in the field biologist's survey.

questions.explanation: Honorifics signal respect and professionalism. Omitting them can seem blunt.
